# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{base}/{head}

Get a pull request by base and head branch references

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-224`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| base | path | string | True |
| head | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**200** — PullRequest

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | PR ID |
| `number` | int64 | PR index |
| `title` | string | PR title |
| `state` | string | open/closed |
| `merged` | bool | Whether merged |
| `base` | PRBranchInfo | Base branch info |
| `head` | PRBranchInfo | Head branch info |

- **404** — Pull request or head repo not found
